description: This file defines a React component for a sidebar navigation menu in a web application, including utility functions for path normalization and active link determination.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a URL path by removing trailing slashes except for root.

methods.name: startsWithPathSegment
methods.description: Checks if a pathname starts with a given path segment.

methods.name: isNavItemActive
methods.description: Determines if a navigation item should be marked active based on the current pathname.

methods.name: SidebarNavigation
methods.description: The main React component rendering the sidebar navigation, handles display logic and interactions.
